channel.title: Jaeheung Lee | Manufacturing & Process Engineer
channel.description: Manufacturing and process-engineering portfolio covering battery production, semiconductor components, equipment FAT/SAT, quality improvement, and manufacturing DX

item.title: 2170 Assembly-Line Good-Yield Stabilization
item.description: Displayed yield and shop-floor loss did not agree, so teams prioritized different causes. Monthly average good yield reached 98.7% in December 2024 from an initial level of about 40%, followed by SOP, QCP, and P-FMEA updates.

item.title: FAT/SAT of 11 Core Machines for an NCM Prismatic Pilot Line
item.description: Individual auto cycles could not prove end-to-end flow, safety, repeatability, or pilot-production readiness. Initial assembly yield was about 95% across roughly 1,000 cells over five days, including reworked cells that met quality criteria.

item.title: Vacuum-Robot Overhaul Standardization
item.description: Experience-dependent assembly and inspection created variation in work time and missed checks. The SOP and checklist were applied in the field; team monthly output increased from 1–2 to 4–5 units during the same period.

item.title: High-Temperature Anodizing Film Development for OLED Parts
item.description: Film cracking and particles recurred within warranty life under repeated high-temperature use. The revised condition entered production and was monitored for about a year through the transition period.

item.title: AMAT/AKT CVD & PECVD Component Qualification
item.description: Stable internal results were insufficient when customer measurement methods and acceptance criteria differed. The technical qualification was completed, but the company ended the business about a year later because of the product mix and profitability.

item.title: Diffuser Ultrasonic-Stripping Scale-up Failure and Validation Gates
item.description: Roughness, diffusion, and product-reuse risks remained open at lab scale before equipment fabrication proceeded. Normal operation was not achieved; the case produced explicit gates for sample quality, reusability, equipment conditions, and stopping criteria.

item.title: Indy7 Robot Control and Status Monitoring System
item.description: Separate robot connections from HMI, database, and twin services blur command ownership and current state; JSON rewrites can also break references. The public code verifies command, state, history, and read-only Web Twin paths; Omniverse is explicitly a future extension.

item.title: Building an AI Model to Find Defects in Welding Images
item.description: A model that performed well on public data still had to be checked against field images with different lighting, angles, and surfaces. Field-image recall initially fell to 15.84%; the ResNet–DeiT combination improved it to 93.07% in the limited evaluation.

item.title: Testing Equipment Expansion in a Virtual Factory
item.description: Finding sequence and communication issues only after equipment installation makes tryout expensive. The team connected Factory I/O, PLC, SCADA, and OPC UA in one educational demonstration and defined a virtual-commissioning checklist.

item.title: HeungTology for Collecting and Searching Manufacturing Knowledge
item.description: Manufacturing, semiconductor, and battery knowledge accumulated with inconsistent terms and links, making evidence retrieval difficult. The current public main includes the knowledge vault, link-graph index, and sync/query flow.

item.title: Deep Learning Model Study Log
item.description: Running example code once is different from an experiment whose data, settings, and evaluation can be explained and reproduced. The current public main is a README-based archive of learning topics and experiment criteria.

item.title: Study Masterbook for Maintenance Engineer Exam Candidates
item.description: Exam answers, theory, and image rights come from different evidence, so fluent AI completion can create incorrect learning material. The masterbook publishes only supported items and keeps conflicting or rights-uncertain material on HOLD.

item.title: Guidebook for Common Unemployment Benefit Questions
item.description: Similar questions can produce different outcomes based on separation reason, insured period, documents, and individual notice; a website should not decide eligibility. The operating guide helps users find facts, documents, and official channels rather than issuing personal determinations.

item.title: AI Agent Experiment That Checks Evidence Before Acting
item.description: An AI reading data and proposing an action does not prove authority to execute or a safe external result. The local experiment stops work outside the approved scope and checks the state before and after execution.
